issue.title: Fix FK failure in chapter assignment sync for PM with no assigned work
issue.body:
## Summary

Post-login sync can fail with a SQLite foreign key error when inserting chapter assignment sync data. Reported while reviewing [#230](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/230) for a project manager who has active projects but **no assigned translation work**.

This looks unrelated to the bible-text full-fetch change in #230 (that PR only fills bible texts when local verse count is zero). Tracking here so #230 can merge separately.

## Repro

1. Fresh install / clear local DB.
2. Sign in as a project manager against the dev cloud DB.
3. User has active projects but no assigned chapter translation work.
4. Observe post-login sync failure.

## Observed

From the review logs on #230:

- `[SyncService] User chapter work sync failed, retrying` with `FOREIGN KEY constraint failed` from op-sqlite
- Failure path: `insertChapterAssignmentSyncData` during user chapter work sync (retries ×3, then post-login sync fails)
- App log: `[App] Post-login sync failed` with the same FK error

## Expected

Post-login sync should succeed (or soft-fail without blocking) for users who have projects but no chapter assignments. FK inserts should not reference missing parent rows.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reproduce (or unit/integration cover) FK failure path around `insertChapterAssignmentSyncData` for empty / orphan assignment payloads
- [ ] Fix ordering or filtering so chapter assignment sync does not insert rows that violate FKs when the user has no assigned work
- [ ] Post-login sync no longer fails for a PM with active projects and zero assignments
- [ ] Add or extend a test covering this case

## File pointers

- `src/db/repository.ts` — `insertChapterAssignmentSyncData`
- `src/services/sync.ts` — user chapter work sync calling that insert
- `App.tsx` — post-login `syncAllData` catch / log

## Related product note (not blocking the bug)

Home defaults to the My Work tab via `useState<HomeTab>('myWork')` in `src/app/screens/HomeScreen.tsx`. kaseywright asked whether Product wants that for all roles (including PMs with no assigned work). Confirm with Product; change only if they want a different default (e.g. Projects).

## Links

- Review / screenshots: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/230#pullrequestreview-4755780308

comments.body:
**Needs re-verification on current `main`** (tracker cleanup note).

Since this was filed, `main` gained migration/sync hardening that nulls orphan `assigned_user_id` values when the user row is not local (part of #99 / #248 — see `insertChapterAssignmentSyncData` in `src/db/repository.ts`).

Please re-test the original PM repro (active projects, zero assigned chapter work, fresh DB, post-login sync):
- If sync succeeds → close this issue (or narrow AC to any remaining failure mode).
- If it still fails → keep open and attach fresh logs.

Leaving Project Status as Backlog until that check.

## API readiness note (board audit)

**Status on fluent-api `main`:** Present for chapter-assignment sync — `GET /users/{userId}/chapter-assignments/all` (and related) exist. Bug is local insert ordering/FK when payloads are empty/orphan for PMs with projects but no assigned work.

**Implement with:** Fix mobile repository/sync filtering. No mock API; use real (or empty) sync payloads.

### Follow up with fluent-api team
When you pick this up, please ask the fluent-api team:
1. Is the needed feature planned / in progress?
2. Expected ETA (or “not scheduled”)?
3. Is there already an open fluent-api GitHub issue or PR? If yes, link it here; if no, ask them to file one (or file it yourself and link it).

Checked against local fluent-api `main` @ `3ef4025` (2026-07-31).
